title: Red, then green
note: A dark, CI-native page whose hero is a working release gate on a sample spec pull request: the Python SDK is held back with its one-line spec fix, and the visitor applies it, watches the check go green and publishes every surface together, before the page covers the checks, the two decisions left for a person, the receipt and the path from free eval to paid gate.

credits.author: Doctorine horse mark from the gallery
